subtopic_title: Addition and subtraction of numbers and place values

record_links.rationale: This worked example subtracts whole numbers by aligning place values and regrouping between columns.

record.answer_text:
Step 1: Write the numbers one below the other. Line up the units, tens, hundreds, thousands, and so on.

$$
\begin{array}{r r}
  & \text{th}\, \text{h}\, \text{t}\, \text{u} \\
 & 4,0\,3\,2 \\
         - & 1\,7\,8 \\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$

Step 2: Subtract the units column. If there are not enough units to subtract from, move one group from the tens column to the units column.

- We cannot subtract 8 from 2.
- There are 3 groups of 10 in the tens column. Move one of them to the units column.
- The units column now has the value $10+2=12$.
- The tens column has only 2 groups of 10 left.

$$
\begin{array}{r r}
  & \text{th}\;\, \text{h}\;\, \text{t}\;\, \text{u}\; \\
  &_{2}\;\,_{12} \\
 & 4,0\,\cancel{3}\cancel{2} \\
         - & 1\;\,7\;8\;\, \\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$

Now we can subtract the units: $12-8=4$

$$
\begin{array}{r r}
  & \text{th}\;\, \text{h}\;\, \text{t}\;\, \text{u}\; \\
  &_{2}\;\,_{12} \\
 & 4,0\,\cancel{3}\cancel{2} \\
- & 1\;\,7\;8\;\, \\
   \hline
  &4\;\,\\
   \hline
   \end{array}
$$

Step 3: Repeat Step 2 with the tens column. If necessary, move one group from the hundreds column to the tens column.

- We cannot subtract 7 from 2.
- There are no groups in the hundreds column. We must move one group from the thousands column to the hundreds column.
- There are 4 groups of 1,000 in the thousands column. Move one of them to the hundreds column.
- The hundreds column now has 1 group of 1,000. This is equal to 10 groups of 100.
- The thousands column has only 3 groups of 1,000 left.

$$
\begin{array}{r r}
  & \text{th}\phantom{0}\; \text{h}\phantom{0}\; \text{t}\phantom{0} \text{u}\; \\
  &_{3}\;\;_{10}\,\;\;_{2}\,\;_{12}\, \\
 & \cancel{4},\cancel{0}\,\cancel{3}\cancel{2} \\
         - & 1\;\;\,7\;\,8\; \\
 \hline
 &4\;\,\\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$

Now we can move one group from the hundreds column to the tens column.

The tens column now has 12 groups of 10.
The hundreds column only has 9 groups of 100 left.

$$
\begin{array}{r r}
  & \text{th}\phantom{0}\; \text{h}\phantom{0}\; \text{t}\phantom{0} \text{u}\; \\
  &_{3}\;\;\; _{9}\;\;_{12}\,_{12}\, \\
 & \cancel{4},\cancel{0}\,\cancel{3}\cancel{2} \\
         - & 1\;\;\,7\;\,8\; \\
    \hline
 &4\;\,\\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$

Now we can subtract the tens: $12-7=5$

$$
\begin{array}{r r}
  & \text{th}\phantom{0}\; \text{h}\phantom{0}\; \text{t}\phantom{0} \text{u}\; \\
  &_{3}\;\;\; _{9}\;\;_{12}\,_{12}\, \\
 & \cancel{4},\cancel{0}\,\cancel{3}\cancel{2} \\
         - & 1\;\;\,7\;\,8\; \\
    \hline
 &5\;\,4\;\\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$

Step 4: Repeat Step 3 with the hundreds and thousands.

$$\text{Hundreds}:\space9-1=8$$
$$
\begin{array}{r r}
  & \text{th}\phantom{0}\; \text{h}\phantom{0}\; \text{t}\phantom{0} \text{u}\; \\
  &_{3}\;\;\; _{9}\;\;_{12}\,_{12}\, \\
 & \cancel{4},\cancel{0}\,\cancel{3}\cancel{2} \\
         - & 1\;\;\,7\;\,8\; \\
    \hline
 &8\;\;\,5\;\,4\;\\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$
$$\text{Thousands}:\space3-0=3$$
$$
\begin{array}{r r}
  & \text{th}\phantom{0}\; \text{h}\phantom{0}\; \text{t}\phantom{0} \text{u}\; \\
  &_{3}\;\;\; _{9}\;\;_{12}\,_{12}\, \\
 & \cancel{4},\cancel{0}\,\cancel{3}\cancel{2} \\
         - & 1\;\;\,7\;\,8\; \\
    \hline
 &3,\phantom{0}8\;\;\,5\;\,4\;\\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$

record.prompt_text:
### Exercise 5.2: Add and subtract whole numbers

3. Determine the difference in the two place values of 5 in the following numbers.

To determine the difference between two numbers, subtract the smaller number from the larger number.

1. 1,025,568
2. 58,753
3. 5,198,352
record.answer_text:
1. 1,025,568
The place values are 5,000 and 500.
$$
\begin{array}{r r}
&_4 \phantom{00} _{10}\phantom{00}\\
& \cancel{5},\cancel{0}00 \\
- & 5\;00 \\
\hline
& 4\,,\;5\;00\\
\hline
\end{array}
$$

2. 58,753
The place values are 50,000 and 50.
$$
\begin{array}{r r}
&_4\;\;\,_9\;\;\;\, _{10}\phantom{0}\\
& \cancel{5}\cancel{0},\cancel{0}\cancel{0}0 \\
- & 5\;0 \\
\hline
& 4\;\;9\,,\;9\;5\;0\\
\hline
\end{array}
$$

3. 5,198,352
The place values are 5,000,000 and 50.
$$
\begin{array}{r r}
&_4\;\;\;_9\;\;\,_9\;\; _9\;\;\;\; _9\;\; _{10}\phantom{0}\\
& \cancel{5},\cancel{0}\cancel{0}\cancel{0},\cancel{0}\cancel{0}0 \\
- & 5\;0 \\
\hline
& 4,\;\;9\;\;9\;\;9\;,\;9\;\,5\;0\\
\hline
\end{array}
$$
